summary: User cannot create visibility database schema for MySQL 8.0.45 when self-hosting Temporal v1.29 via Helm due to SQL syntax error in the manage-schema-visibility-store job.
userImpact: Users attempting to self-host Temporal v1.29 with MySQL 8.0.45 cannot create the visibility database schema, blocking deployment setup.
rootCause: SQL syntax error in schema creation statement - possible character encoding or MySQL version-specific JSON column syntax incompatibility near JSON field references
keyQuote: Error 1064 (42000): You have an error in your SQL syntax... near '"$.TemporalChangeVersion"), ADD COLUMN BinaryChecksums JSON'
